proposed_preset_contract.runtime_format: flattened PCM plus own region/preset manifest; SFZ/SF2 import only
proposed_preset_contract.note: Unknown absent source values stay null, not fabricated. A converter must normalize source defaults and SFZ inclusive loop semantics explicitly; manifests here retain original source opcodes, not production-ready converted regions.
proposed_preset_contract.velocity: Nonoverlapping regions first; no gate-1 round robin. Preserve original velocity 0..127 and note-off separately.
proposed_preset_contract.sustain: Pitched voices: per-voice note-off release; CC64 defers note-off; release samples optional.
proposed_preset_contract.realtime: Decode/load off audio thread; renderer no file IO or allocations; bound voices and stealing, sizes not yet approved.
proposed_preset_contract.alignment: Same preset IDs + preset version + source/derived checksums + parameter values + seed (where used), event ordering/timebase, tuning, sample rate policy, gain, envelope and choke semantics across platforms and future stem render. IDs alone do not imply bit-identical output or alignment. Preserve MIDI provenance independently.
proposed_preset_contract.export: No native Ableton export or integrated stem render claimed.
